summary.intent: Run a CodeRabbit CLI review on the phase-47 branch (user was rate-limited on web reviews), then fix all confirmed findings before committing.
summary.outcome: All 3 CodeRabbit CLI findings were verified as real and fixed: major pin leak in deleteFileVersion (SDK + web layer), plus 2 missing cas test cases. Adversarial workflow confirmed correctness; 204 sdk-core tests and 9 client-file-ops tests pass, full root typecheck exits 0. Commit staged and running in background at transcript end.

repo: deleteFileVersion was asymmetric with its sibling methods: replaceFile (lines 1172, 1224) and restoreFileVersion (lines 1283, 1313) both capture and return prunedCids from updateFileMetadata, but deleteFileVersion did a bare await and dropped them.
apps/web typechecks against the built sdk dist — must rebuild sdk before running web tsc -b or cross-package type errors will be stale.
Root `pnpm typecheck` is the authoritative cross-package check: it builds the full dep chain (crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk) then runs tsc -b for web.

sdk integration tests are skipped in CI via `process.env.CI ? describe.skip : describe` (line 26 of client-file-ops.test.ts) and require a live server at localhost:3000 — pre-existing, not a signal of test failures.
publishWithCas engine had no test coverage for: (1) null re-resolve after 409 (should throw ConflictError without calling decodeRemote/merge) and (2) multi-round prunedCids accumulation and dedup.
Phase-47 merge-base with main is commit 4b539b445; the branch spans 13 commits across sdk-core/sdk/web.

code.finding: deleteFileVersion did a bare await on updateFileMetadata, silently dropping prunedCids returned from conflict-merge rounds — orphaned pins on quota.
replaceFile correctly captures prunedCids from updateFileMetadata and returns them as Promise<{ prunedCids }> — the reference pattern for the deleteFileVersion fix.
restoreFileVersion correctly captures prunedCids from updateFileMetadata and returns them — second reference pattern confirming the asymmetry.
handleDeleteVersion unpinned only deletedCid; prunedCids from conflict-merge rounds were never unpinned.

restoreVersion hook ignores SDK-returned prunedCids and uses only web-computed prunedCids from computeRestoreVersionUpdate — same latent conflict-merge pin leak, confirmed out-of-scope but flagged for follow-up.
Test 4c originally re-invoked publishWithCas a second time inside a try/catch to assert error properties, causing mock bleed; tidied to single invocation based on adversarial review finding.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI review scoped with `--base-commit <merge-base>` produces a clean per-phase diff review without touching unrelated history.

Three-lens adversarial workflow (pin-leak correctness, test validity, scope/regression) before committing caught a redundant second publishWithCas call in a new test and surfaced the out-of-scope restoreFileVersion latent leak.
1Password git signer is unreliable mid-session; background + unsandboxed commit (TaskCreate) is the proven workaround after an app restart recovers the signer.
Edit tool requires unique string anchors — when two code blocks share the same structure (restore vs delete), anchor on surrounding unique context or the block end to avoid ambiguous match errors.

friction: Rate-limited on CodeRabbit web/PR reviews; had to fall back to the CLI tool.
1Password signer failed mid-session, requiring an app restart before the prior commit (78e5f3d59) could land.
Edit tool collisions when two structurally identical blocks (restoreFileVersion and deleteFileVersion test blocks) shared the same match string — required multiple retries with different anchors.
open_items: restoreFileVersion web hook (useFileVersions.ts:102-109) has the same conflict-merge pin leak: it discards SDK-returned prunedCids and only unpins web-computed ones from computeRestoreVersionUpdate. Confirmed out-of-scope for this PR; needs a dedicated follow-up.
Commit for the phase-47 review fixes was still running in the background (Task b33lwmkfm) at transcript end — push and PR thread resolution not yet confirmed.
